digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration — OpenAI API variants
propositions: pydantic-ai 1.107.2 constructs OpenAIResponsesModel for openai-responses: prefix but rebar's KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES and provider resolution logic lack openai-responses entries, making the prefix unusable in rebar despite pydantic-ai support

contract tests parameterized over openai-chat: and openai-responses: prefixes verify identical behavior for structured output, streaming, tool calls, retry, and custom-base-URL routing against real pydantic-ai model construction with stubbed HTTP transport

four rebar code sites block openai-responses: migration today: KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES qualifier absence, _pydantic_ai_known_providers resolution, _PROFILE_RESOLVERS capability mapping, and openai:→openai-chat: normalizer hard-coding

hosted OpenAI is Responses-ready at pydantic-ai layer but custom base_url endpoints (LMStudio/Ollama/vLLM), gateway/openai, and third-party vendors (deepseek, grok, xai, groq, cerebras, moonshot, heroku) are Chat-Completions-only or UNKNOWN under the current pin
